statements.impact_statement: Trivy reports both fastmcp 3.4.4 and fastmcp-slim 3.4.4 in this exact image; the fixed release is 3.4.10 or later in the compatible major line. The vulnerable authorization behavior was not individually assessed.
statements.action_statement: Reconcile the FastMCP lock to a compatible fixed release, rerun protocol and calendar fixture tests, then rebuild and issue a new image-specific assessment. This statement is not a waiver.

statements.impact_statement: Trivy reports opentelemetry-api 1.44.0 in this exact image; the fixed version is 1.45.1. Application-level exposure to attacker-controlled header parsing was not assessed.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade the compatible locked opentelemetry-api dependency, rerun tests and image smoke, then rebuild and issue a new image-specific assessment. This statement is not a waiver.
